probes.name: byte
probes.macro:
Public Type InnerData
A As Byte
B As Long
End Type
Public Type RecordData
A As Byte
End Type
Function Probe() As String
Dim item As RecordData
Probe = CStr(Len(item)) & "|" & CStr(LenB(item))
End Function

probes.name: fixed_string_storage
probes.macro:
Private Type RecordData
Text As String * 3
End Type
Function Probe() As String
Dim first As RecordData, second As RecordData
Probe = CStr(AscW(Mid$(first.Text, 1, 1))) & "|"
first.Text = "abcd"
second = first
first.Text = "x"
Probe = Probe & first.Text & "|" & second.Text & "|" & Len(first) & "|" & LenB(first)
End Function
